frozen_d2a0.source: contract-rev1-1b-a0-fixtures.ts :: D2A0_CONTRACT_TEXT and contract-rev1.ts :: D2A0_ANCHORS / D2A0_PREDICTION
frozen_d2a0.contract_question_literal: Which bucket describes the subject's stance on the proposition shown in the belief line?
frozen_d2a0.measurement_target: the proposition shown in the belief line — in the state experiment, the canonical CAUTION proposition
frozen_d2a0.anchor_for_the_strongest_endorsing_bucke: the subject treats the proposition as settled in its favour and would rely on it without reservation
frozen_d2a0.anchor_for_the_strongest_doubting_bucket: the subject treats the proposition as settled against it and would rely on its denial without reservation
frozen_d2a0.directional_requirement: the HIGH modal bucket lies in the endorsing set AND the LOW modal bucket lies in the doubting set AND the two modal buckets differ

equivalence_claim.why: A0 asks for the subject's stance on the proposition carried in the belief line; in the A0 state experiment that proposition is the canonical CAUTION proposition, so A0's target and D3-A's target are the same object
equivalence_claim.why_buckets: A0's anchors define its extreme buckets as the subject treating the proposition as settled in its favour / against it, i.e. support / oppose of that proposition
equivalence_claim.why_predicate: A0's frozen directional requirement is exactly 'HIGH's modal is in the endorsing set AND LOW's modal is in the doubting set AND they differ', which is 3B1's definition with A0's bucket names
equivalence_claim.only_difference: the proposed D3-A would use three buckets and renamed tokens instead of A0's five

contract_checks.why_that_is_false: the contract lists the three relation names in the schema field, which every instrument must do; it never states which relation holds and never hints at the expected one

design_integrity: D3's design was triggered only by the fact that D2-A1 produced a valid null; the specific LOW 5 SUPPORTS + 1 UNCERTAIN pattern was not used to choose tokens, wording, thresholds or expected directions, and the D3-B fixtures use a synthetic workshop proposition unrelated to CAUTION
